note: The ONLY place branding should live. Colors here are a proposed starting palette from the design review, not a final decision — swap them (and church.json, and assets/brand/logo if one is added) to re-skin this whole app for another church. Because manifest.webmanifest and favicons are fetched by the browser before any JavaScript runs, changing colors here also means updating manifest.webmanifest's theme_color/background_color by hand — see docs/MANAGE.md.
